summary: Install-time execution of multi-layer-obfuscated payload via binding.gyp command expansion
details: The package's scripts.install runs node-gyp rebuild, and binding.gyp uses GYP command-expansion (`<!(env node index.js...; echo stub.c)`) in its sources list to invoke index.js during the configure phase. The binding.gyp declares target type 'none' and ships no C/C++ sources, so there is nothing to actually build — the file exists solely to trigger execution of index.js at install. index.js is a ~586 KB Caesar-shifted (+5) character-code array passed to eval; the decoded program imports node:crypto and uses createDecipheriv('aes-128-gcm',...) to decrypt further hex ciphertext blobs and execute the plaintext. No readable logic, URLs, or purpose is exposed in source. Installing this package on a default `npm install` runs this opaque encrypted payload on the installer's machine. CWE-506.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
